none: PAS CAM-77F4B6: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy nummus of the House of Theodosius, AD 378-402
contea di ritrovamento: City of Peterborough (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Theodosius, AD 378-402 (Reece period 21). Reverse legend reads [VICTORIA AV]GGG. Reverse shows Victory advancing left, holding wreath and palm. Mint is Arles, AD 388-402. Obverse legend is illegible. Obverse shows diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //PCON. Die axis is 6 o'clock. Weight is 0.88g, diameter is 12.1mm,…
